name: paperwork-eu

init: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.persona-preview, [data-preview-exit] { display: none !important; }'; document.head.append(s); });

previewNote: The mock shows these entry states as Review personas: its 'Previewing' banner and the preview-only 'My area is Cologne' button are review tools, so the mock side hides them (init) before anything is measured.
seedNote: The app signs in as the sibling <name>+eu@…, with PaperworkSeeder's EU persona: the mock's six answers and no task started (MockSample\PaperworkEntrySeeder). The plan then suggests the same three tasks as the mock, and no residence task.
overviewNote: This config measures PW6's note only. The overview above it is PW2's (session 2): the mock's EU persona has 'Your situation' and a question card above the tasks, and its task cards carry a line the app's don't yet, so the note sits higher in the app (93.5px, and a line less on phones). Its box, words and styles are compared; its y and pixels wait for PW2.
